threads.body: The description states that database client metrics are enabled, but in this entry metrics are only referenced under `otel.semconv-stability.opt-in=database`. To avoid misleading readers, clarify in the description that metrics are emitted only when that opt-in is enabled (or, if metrics are intended to be on by default, add the corresponding `metric_refs` to the `when: default` block).

+- name: hbase-client-1.0
+  display_name: HBase Client
+  description: |
+    This instrumentation enables database client spans and database client metrics for the Apache HBase client.
+  semantic_conventions:
+  - DATABASE_CLIENT_SPANS
+  - DATABASE_CLIENT_METRICS
+  library_link: https://hbase.apache.org/
+  source_path: instrumentation/hbase/hbase-client-1.0
+  scope:
+    name: io.opentelemetry.hbase-client-1.0
+  has_javaagent: true
+  javaagent_target_versions:
+  - org.apache.hbase:hbase-client:[1.0.0,1.4.0)
+  telemetry:
+  - when: default
+    spans:
+    - span_kind: CLIENT
+      attributes:
+      - name: db.name
+        type: STRING
+      - name: db.operation
+        type: STRING
+      - name: db.system
+        type: STRING
+      - name: db.user
+        type: STRING
+      - name: server.address
+        type: STRING
+      - name: server.port
+        type: LONG
+  - when: otel.semconv-stability.opt-in=database
